sentences.text: The genus is known from teeth that are subtriangular to rhomboidal in shape.
Richard Owen named the genus Petalodus in 1840.
The type species of the genus is Petalodus hastingsii — the species the genus is based on.
Petalodus belongs to the family Petalodontidae.
It is classified in the class Chondrichthyes, a group of cartilaginous fish.
Petalodus lived during the Pennsylvanian and Permian periods.
This span covers 346.7 to 264.9 million years ago, from the Visean to the Wordian stages.
